atoms.b: The verb and the ((++subject object noun)) of a sentence must agree with one another.
In the present tense, if the subject is a third-person singular, ((++-s -z -ss)) is usually added to the verb.
For example: Valerie ((++recommends recommendz)) the greatest shows.
